title: Long solutions to small equations
summary: We give complete solutions of thirty-eight Diophantine equations left open in Grechuk's 2024 monograph: fifteen affine equations, five generalized Fermat equations, eight plane quartics, and ten further homogeneous equations. All proofs were generated by AI and require substantial computer algebra computations.
tags: Diophantine equations; Chabauty method;  Brauer--Manin obstruction
